description: This is a test configuration file for pytest that sets up fixtures for testing a FastAPI application. It includes fixtures for creating a test client, a session with the API, and ensuring environment variables are set to safe defaults during tests.

methods.name: client()
methods.description: Creates a new FastAPI TestClient instance for each test, allowing interaction with the API in a test environment.

methods.name: str session_id(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Creates a new session via API and returns its session ID, verifying the response and ensuring the session is created properly.

methods.name: _default_env(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch)
methods.description: Sets environment variables to default safe values for testing, removing any existing environment variables that could affect test behavior.
